title: Understand Absolute Value of Rational Numbers
objective: I can find the absolute value of a rational number — an integer, fraction, or decimal — as its distance from zero.
model: number line with the number marked and its distance from 0 counted (|a| = distance, never direction; opposites mirror about 0)

widgets.where: Practice 4.7; Challenge 3.1-3.2 (act:nline mode abs L2, L3, L4)
widgets.component: tap the line to mark numbers for 'distance from' prompts
widgets.root: mkAbs in assets/studio-act/nline.js draws three kinds: |x| = d (kind 'zero'), 'the number d units right/left of a' (kind 'one': signed addition) and 'both numbers d units from a' (kind 'both': |x − a| = d, the distance between two points that 7-6 teaches). L1-L2 pick zero/one/zero, L3 picks both/one/both, L4 is always 'both', so Challenge 3.1 and 3.2 never ask |x| = d at all and Practice 4.7 is off-objective one draw in three.
widgets.replacement: Add a lesson parameter and pin 7-3 to distance from 0. In nline.js mkAbs honour p.from === 'zero' and force kind 'zero' at every level; pass {mode:'abs', from:'zero'} in data/practice-studio/7-3.json items t4i7, t3i1, t3i2. Task: 'Mark every number x where |x| = d' on the level's own line (L1 integers on −10..10, L2 halves, L3 quarters shown as fractions or decimals, L4 thirds, fifths or hundredths), two points required, mirror line at 0 drawn, graded as a set. Traps to keep or add: only +d placed ('distance can go left or right'), only −d placed, and a point measured from some other number. Keep the 'd units from a' variants for 7-6 where they belong.

widgets.component: |−150|, 'which craft is farther from sea level', 'which craft is at the lower position'
widgets.root: The three items are the lesson's Connect checks without their scenario (config connect.scenario: submarine at −150 m, helicopter at +200 m). The stems say 'the submarine' and 'which craft' with no craft introduced and no figure; the givens survive only inside the answer choices, and the correct 5.2 choice states its own reasoning ('200 > 150').
widgets.replacement: Restore the scenario: state 'A submarine is at −150 m and a helicopter at +200 m' in each stem and add viz {t:'nline', min:-250, max:250, step:50, marks:[{v:-150,l:'Submarine'},{v:200,l:'Helicopter'}]}. Keep three separate questions (|−150|; which is farther = compare absolute values; which is lower = compare signed values) so the distance-versus-position trap stays, and rewrite the 5.2/5.3 choices as bare results ('helicopter', 'submarine', 'same') so the reason is not handed over.
